comment: Options menu, bind keys, key first: '~', which has no binding, to "nothing" (cmd.c handler_rebind_keys_add(), Strcat() at line 2363). On Linux bind_key("nothing") succeeds and the `else if (!prevcmd)` arm prints "Bound key '~' to \"nothing\"."; on macOS the bind fails. Seed and inputs chosen for the 2026-11-15 review. Recorded on macOS by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml, not on Linux: cmd.c handler_rebind_keys_add() appends with Strcat() to the uninitialized cmdstr (line 2356). On the judge's macOS build that buffer does not start with a zero byte, so bind_key() matches no command and line 2402 prints "Key binding failed?!"; a Linux recorder happens to bind the key (docs/testing.md, "The key-binding difference").
